title: Lena flow timing did not clearly confirm the Yenisey timing gap in certified 1980-2011 data
abstract: We tested whether the annual-minus-spring flow midpoint gap found at Yenisey-Igarka also increased at Lena-Kyusyur. We used 32 complete certified years from ArcticGRO v20261104. The Lena gap slope was 1.60 days per decade, with 97.5% five-year block limits of -1.00 to 4.10. The Yenisey-minus-Lena slope difference was -0.58, with limits of -3.08 to 2.07. These two primary tests give no clear Lena increase or basin difference. They do not establish equal changes. The Yenisey gap was positive in the matched period. A 1990 start gave a larger positive Lena gap and a negative basin contrast. A wider spring window also gave a positive Lena gap. Thus endpoint and metric choices limit the result. A secondary Ob check was uncertain. This extends prior campaign work to other basins with the same source product; it is not independent source confirmation. Code, aggregate results, source hashes, a numerical audit and a figure permit reproduction. Raw data and annual tables remain external. No climate or reservoir cause is established.
